title: figure_drafts
description: What the figure designer returns from its drafts step (Implementation Decisions 13; research-notes 11 Section 4.1, step 3): one entry per candidate code handed it, rendered or not. A draft that did not render is reported with its error, never left out; code checks every PNG on disk and every pitfall against the ones the index handed in.

index_id.description: the candidate's id, exactly as the prompt named it

generator.description: the draft's script, relative to the project

png.description: the draft's PNG at the target width, relative to the project

error.description: why the draft did not render: the last lines of the traceback

pitfalls_consulted.description: the pitfalls the prompt listed for this candidate that were read before drawing it, copied verbatim

traps.description: a library trap met while drawing that no listed pitfall named; promote_to_index when the plot index should carry it
